analyst_view.overall: Early view: Real Oviedo (9th) under Julián Calero won 2-1 at Cádiz in November with Estanis Pedrola and Ilyas Chaira back from injury, but have taken most of their points away (13 of 21) rather than at the Tartiere. Striker Chris Ramos is out for at least the rest of the calendar year with a torn cruciate ligament, and Dani Calvo went off injured at Cádiz with no timeline yet. Real Sociedad B (17th) under Jon Ansotegi are a young side fighting relegation.
